recipe.twist: The twin statues at the center turn to face you wherever you stand. They are the Maze's first eyes.
recipe.secret: A relic glints on an island in the lava pool to the northeast. Unreachable until someone in the party learns Float (Mystic Lv3) and equips it.
recipe.story: Scratched into the west wall: 'It let me leave once. It wanted me to come back.'

features.name: The Old Lancer
features.text: An old soldier leans on a hooked spear. "Everything here pushes. Learn to push back." You can now take up the Lancer job.
features.after: The Old Lancer: "Pull them in, shove them out. The grid is a weapon."

features.name: A Ranger's Bow
features.text: At the edge of the lava pool, a bow rests on a bed of bones, still strung. Notches on the grip count something. You can now take up the Ranger job.
features.after: The bow's previous owner counted to forty-one.

features.name: The Cinder Eye
features.text: You float over the lava and lift the relic: a glass eye, warm, its pupil the same shape as the statues' gaze. It blinks. Every member gains 12 job XP. Somewhere, the Maze notices that you came this far.
